decisions.reason: As an extension of the firm's established psychiatric treatment offer in a growing care field, it remains strategically well aligned and likely to stay.

The carpentry workshop still fits the firm's therapeutic and sheltered-work capabilities, but its more market-facing custom-furniture element keeps withdrawal risk noticeably higher than for core care services.
Outpatient sociotherapy is closely connected to the firm's person-centered community support model and is therefore likely to be retained.
Counseling for senior living is tightly linked to the eldercare business and appears to support the firm's broader senior-service pathway, making continuation very likely.

Meal delivery for seniors complements ambulatory and everyday-life support, but as a newer and more operationally demanding service it carries a moderate risk of being discontinued if uptake is limited.
